user.title: Eversolo device
user.description: Give the player a name (it becomes the prefix of entity ids, e.g. media_player.eversolo) and enter its IP address. The default API port is 9529.

authorize.title: Confirm on the device
authorize.description: Open the confirmation request on the Eversolo screen (host {host}) and allow Home Assistant, then press Submit.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the device. Check the address and that it is on the same network.
error.not_authorized: The device has not confirmed the connection yet.
